title: simple corpse esp
features: makes it easier to see corpses so you can clean them up, i might make a better script for this game with multiple features some time later
script:
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("StuffOfTheDead"):WaitForChild("Corpses")

local function do_esp(v)
	if v:IsA("Model") and not v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Highlight") then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(230, 57, 70)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.6
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = v
	end
end

for _, v in folder:GetChildren() do do_esp(v) end
folder.ChildAdded:Connect(do_esp)
